technical_and_design_decisions: Target Java 17+ and Spring Framework 6.0 as per the specification.
For U1, extend the binding configuration to support multiple target/source systems by allowing list-based or map-based connection properties.
For U2, update the HDFS module resolution logic to use Hadoop's HA NameNode client APIs instead of the non-HA proxy.
For U3 and U4, adapt the existing XD modules (Cassandra sink, PMML processor) to the Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) binder and module conventions.
For U5 and U6, add new REST controller endpoints in the XD admin server to expose job composition flags and graph data (e.g., in JSON format).
For U7 and U8, update the XD admin UI to conditionally render composition graphs and provide navigation links to job details regardless of composition state.
assumptions: The developer has prior experience with Spring XD, Spring Cloud Stream, and the specific modules being ported.
Testing environments for HDFS HA, Cassandra, and PMML are readily available.
The existing XD UI framework can be easily extended to support the required visual differentiations and click-through navigation.
No major refactoring of the core XD runtime is required to support the new REST endpoints or multiple bindings.
Effort estimates represent development work only and exclude project management and deployment overhead.

activities.activity_description: Design and implement the ability to connect to multiple external systems for the same binding type, allowing data to be read from one and written to another. Includes configuration parsing and integration testing.

activities.activity_name: Fix HDFS custom module location for NameNode HA (U2)
activities.activity_description: Update the HDFS module resolution logic to support High Availability (HA) NameNodes, replacing the non-HA proxy with the appropriate HA client configuration.
Migrate the Cassandra module from Spring XD to the Spring Cloud Stream repository, adapting it to function as a sink module in a streaming pipeline.
Migrate the analytic-pmml module from Spring XD to the Spring Cloud Stream repository, adapting it to function as a processor module in a streaming pipeline.

activities.activity_name: Implement job composition REST endpoints (U5, U6)
activities.activity_description: Develop REST endpoints in the XD admin server to return the job composition flag and the job composition graph for visual representation of parent-child relationships.

activities.activity_name: Update UI for job composition visualization (U7, U8)
activities.activity_description: Modify the XD admin UI to visually differentiate between job-composition workflows and single jobs, and enable click-through navigation to the detail page for both singular and composed jobs.
Perform end-to-end integration testing of all new features, verify backward compatibility, and fix any identified bugs.
Update relevant documentation, including configuration guides for multiple bindings, HDFS HA, and the new REST endpoints.
